case_name: Timothy L. Foradis and Jessica L. Moore v. Commissioner
suitability_reason: Only issue (real estate professional status under §469(c)(7)(B)) was decided on the court's rejection of Mr. Foradis's claimed 2,500 construction hours as not credible; no hours finding to compute from.

taxpayer.notes: Both spouses full-time employees; built and rented a short-term rental 'carriage house' beginning October 2020.

adjustments: disallowed $22,376 rental real estate loss deduction
computational adjustment to student loan interest deduction
notice_of_deficiency.contested_by_taxpayer: Deductibility of rental loss (claimed real estate professional status for Mr. Foradis)

findings_of_fact.fact: Schedule E: rents $875, mortgage interest $6,729, depreciation $16,522, loss $22,376
findings_of_fact.snippet: As a result petitioners claimed a rental real estate loss deduction of $22,376.

findings_of_fact.fact: Ms. Moore wages $82,873, full-time ~40 hours/week; did not work on carriage house
findings_of_fact.snippet: In 2020 Ms. Moore earned wage income of $82,873 and worked approximately 40 hours a week
In 2020 Mr. Foradis earned wage income of $78,501 and worked approximately 40 hours a week

findings_of_fact.fact: Mr. Foradis worked approximately 2,000 hours as employee in 2020
findings_of_fact.snippet: Mr. Foradis worked as an employee full time approximately 2,000 hours during 2020.

findings_of_fact.fact: Claimed ~2,500 hours constructing carriage house; found not credible
findings_of_fact.snippet: it does not find it credible that Mr. Foradis spent more hours constructing the carriage house than he did at his full -time job.

findings_of_fact.fact: Notice of deficiency issued June 6, 2023; deficiency $4,953
findings_of_fact.snippet: The IRS also made a computational adjustment to petitioners’ claimed student loan interest deduction and determined a deficiency of $4,953.

issues.question: Other (passive activity loss §469 / real estate professional §469(c)(7)(B)): may petitioners deduct their $22,376 2020 rental real estate loss?
issues.holding: Not deductible: Mr. Foradis failed the more-than-one-half personal services test; 750-hour test not reached
issues.computable_reason: Rests on finding claimed rental hours not credible.

decision.text: Decision will be entered for respondent.
decision.summary: $4,953 deficiency sustained; rental loss disallowed as passive.

notes: Petitioners asserted only Mr. Foradis was a real estate professional. Employment as employee counts as a trade or business for the half-of-services test.
